title: npm user config with registry tokens
whyItMatters: The per-user npmrc often holds registry auth tokens for private packages. A copied token lets someone publish or download private packages under the person's account.
source: npm docs, npmrc: the per-user config file is $HOME/.npmrc: https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/configuring-npm/npmrc
notes: Lines like //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=... are normally stored in plain text. npm also reads project .npmrc files, which this rule does not touch, and NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG can move this file.
